adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the initial `prisma.booking.findFirst({ include: { user: { include: { destinationCalendar: true, credentials: true }}}})` will return `booking.user` with all scalar fields by default (plus the included relations). The later `prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { id: booking.userId || 0 }, select: { name, email, timeZone, locale }})` is therefore an extra DB query that can be avoided by using `booking.user` (with appropriate null handling if `booking.userId`/`booking.user` can be null). This is a concrete perf/duplication issue, but not a correctness defect by itself.
